The consultation itself wasn't bad. The doctor was attentive, answered many questions about my cat's kidney disease, and ordered several tests to assess the progression of the condition.

The problem arose when I needed to schedule a follow-up appointment. The clinic offered only one time slot, incompatible with my availability, and informed me that there was no other option within the return period. As a consequence, I would have to pay for a new consultation and also use up one of the only three specialist consultations offered by the Petlove plan.

I found this absurd. It makes no sense to lose the right to a follow-up appointment due to the clinic's own lack of availability. My cat has stage 3 chronic kidney disease, a disease that requires close monitoring and quick decisions based on tests. It's pointless to order dozens of tests if the specialist can't then make themselves available to analyze them, explain the progression of the disease, and provide detailed guidance on what needs to be done to offer the best possible quality of life for the pet for the time it has left.

Since I couldn't get the follow-up appointment, the tests ended up being interpreted by a veterinarian who isn't a nephrologist, precisely so that the treatment wouldn't be further delayed. I got the feeling that there's a great deal of focus on filling the schedule with initial consultations, but little organization to ensure the continuity of patient follow-up, which is an essential part of treatment. Unfortunately, this experience made me lose confidence in the clinic for long-term care.

Thank you so much for the 5 stars and for your kind words! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

We are very happy with your review. It's a pleasure to know that you had a good experience with us. We are always available to care for our patients with lots of love, attention, and dedication! 🐾❤️

With love,

Pet Hardy Team 🐶🐱
Very attentive and the doctor is quite clear in his explanations.

Veterinarians Ju and Simone are wonderful, attentive, helpful, and great with my boys! I needed to get a serology test done urgently to travel with my cat Valentino to Japan, and it was ready in less than a week, thanks to Ju's dedication. They also issued the CVI (International Veterinary Certificate) for the trip, which is quite bureaucratic. They know their job and are very dedicated. I recommend Pet Hardy without hesitation; I will only bring my boys Dobby and Valentino here! ❤️🙏🏻
